propositions: The parent-first cascade walk logic is duplicated across claim.py and transition.py; extract the shared walk into lifecycle_cascade.py while keeping the decision table _CASCADING_EDGES in transition.py
Three cascading edges exist: open→in_progress, closed→open, and closed→in_progress; the shared walk must preserve all three cascades and the non-cascading behavior of * → closed
The shared cascade_parent_first function must handle benign-race TOCTOU re-checks, cycle guards, and re-raise ConcurrencyMismatch to preserve exit code 10 at the leaf
Callers retain their own write primitives by injecting resolve_parent and advance closures; claim uses eligible_status='open' while transition uses the edge's status
A parametrised test over _CASCADING_EDGES must verify every table row cascades correctly through the real transition surface
